subject: POC kickoff logistics: location, AV, and recording/data policy
messages:
From: Sophie Jenkins <sophie.jenkins@finity.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finity.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 16:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — proposed dates

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Marcus and I are excited to get the hands-on POC scheduled. We're targeting a two-hour working session where we can: walk through our prompts, validate routing rules, and do a short throughput test (~10 concurrent sessions).

Proposed windows (Eastern):
- Tue Sep 7, 10:00–12:00
- Wed Sep 8, 14:00–16:00

Two logistics questions before we lock in a time:
1) We prefer onsite at our NYC ops center (we can host up to 8 visitors). Is Redwood able to do an onsite team for that week, or would you prefer virtual?
2) We need confirmation on whether the session can be recorded (for internal training) and whether Redwood requires a signed visitor access form or specific device rules for laptops/USB.

I've attached a preliminary agenda and our visitor badge form.

Thanks,
Sophie
Sophie Jenkins
Head of Integrations | Finity Payments

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — proposed dates

Hi Sophie — really appreciate the clear agenda. Marcus, thanks for coordinating.

Short answers up front: yes, we can do onsite for Sep 7 or 8; we can also run a hybrid (some folks remote). Recording is fine — we typically record the demo portion for internal playback, but we need explicit consent from everyone on the call and we redact any customer PII from logs before retention. Regarding visitor/device rules, we have two options:

- Onsite: Redwood will send two engineers (me + one infra engineer). We'll sign your visitor forms. We request that no external USBs be used on our laptops; we can bring pre-configured demo laptops.
- Virtual: if you choose virtual, we'll publish a short test checklist (mic/camera/AV checks) and a Join link; no visitor forms needed.

Can you confirm which date and whether you want a fully onsite session (both Redwood engineers physically present) or hybrid? If onsite, we'll need to submit visitor_badge_form.pdf and upload our IDs to your portal if that's your process.

Proposed forward plan once date is confirmed:
- Finalize attendee list (we will send our demo laptop requirements)
- Schedule a 30-minute dry run 2 business days before for routing/load checks
- Confirm recording consent and retention window (Finity preferred retention window?)

If Sep 7 works, we can provision a longer load-test window (30 minutes at 10 concurrent requests) during the session.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0182

From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finity.com>

Thanks Aditya — quick clarifications from our side before we confirm: 

1) Recording: training team prefers recordings to be available for 90 days internal only. Are you able to set that retention window and confirm recordings are stored in a Redteam-controlled bucket with restricted access?
2) Security: our security team requires that visiting engineers have background checks on file and that their laptops run company-approved AV while on-prem. Is Redwood able to run a short attestation for engineers and provide AV logs on request?

We prefer Sep 8 afternoon (14:00–16:00) so we can have our data team present. If Redwood needs Sep 7 for calendar conflicts, let us know.

Marcus
Marcus Lee
Ops Manager | Finity Payments

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@finity.com>, Sophie Jenkins <sophie.jenkins@finity.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 11:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood POC kickoff — proposed dates

Hi Marcus/Sophie — Vivek here (ops at Redwood). Quick point-by-point: 

1) Recording retention: yes, we can set the recording to 90 days and restrict access to the project group. We host recordings in our secure S3 bucket with role-based access; we'll provide a short access matrix and a one-page retention attestation prior to the session.

2) Background checks & AV: our on-call engineers have company background checks and we can provide names + attestations. For onsite sessions we bring locked, pre-configured demo laptops; they will run corporate AV and we can present AV status logs during your security review. We cannot run Finity-managed AV on Redwood machines, but the laptops meet your policy (signature-based AV + EDR).

Operational asks if Finity confirms onsite for Sep 8 14:00–16:00:
- Final attendee list (names & emails) by Sep 1
- Signed visitor badge forms for each Redwood attendee by Sep 3
- 30-min dry run on Sep 6 (same time) — we will test routing and KV cache priming with a small load script.
- Room AV: HDMI + laptop audio + recording permission (we will also record local screen capture).

If you prefer virtual, we'll share a checklist and a 15-min pre-check call on Sep 6.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Ops | Redwood Inference
